card.name: The word possibility after "There is"
card.fires_on: The word "possibility" (or "possible") when it introduces a hedged risk or an uncertain claim, most often after "There is a" or "may be".

modes.label: There is a possibility
modes.description: "possibility" follows "There is a/the" and introduces a possible risk or effect.
modes.example: There is a<< possibility>> of increased bleeding due to pyridox

modes.label: may be possible
modes.description: "possible" follows "may be" in a speculative statement.
modes.example: It may be<< possible>>, thanks to the evacuated tube transport,

card.plain: It marks the spot where a text says something might happen, just before the possible risk or event is named.
